request_shape: GET <endpoint>?basDd=YYYYMMDD with AUTH_KEY header; one request returns every index series of that market for that date in OutBlock_1
request_dates: Every Monday-Friday in the inclusive range. Saturday/Sunday are closed by KRX_EQUITY_MARKET_OPERATION_RULES and are not requested. A weekday is never assumed to be a session; the response decides.

session_classification.SESSION_CONFIRMED: both markets returned non-empty OutBlock_1 with matching BAS_DD
session_classification.NON_SESSION_EMPTY_RESPONSE: both markets returned an empty OutBlock_1
session_classification.DISAGREEMENT: markets disagree, or an official KRX holiday capture for the year disagrees with the responses

storage.records: write-once per (market, basDd) JSON under a caller-supplied directory outside the repository checkout; existing records are validated and reused (resume), never overwritten
retained_fields_private: IDX_NM-matched ratified series CLSPRC_IDX and ACC_TRDVAL as strings
storage.public_outputs: receipt and study aggregates only; no index values
